title: Listing Highlight: 53' Galeon 510 Sky 2020
description: Discover the 2020 Galeon 510 Sky in Miami—a 53-foot modern power yacht with twin Volvo Penta engines, three heads, and 475 gallons of fuel capacity.
html:
A 53-Foot Fiberglass Cruiser With Twin Volvo Penta Engines

The 2020 Galeon 510 Sky represents a compelling opportunity for buyers seeking a contemporary motor yacht with proven engineering and a substantial presence on the water. Based in Miami, Florida, this 53-foot vessel combines practical cruising capability with the refined construction standards Galeon has established across its fleet. The 14.5-foot beam provides excellent stability and interior volume, while the fiberglass hull construction ensures durability and low maintenance.

Powered by twin Volvo Penta D11-670 diesel engines producing 1,340 horsepower combined, the 510 Sky delivers responsive performance for both cruising and spirited running. The engines have logged just 580 hours, indicating minimal wear and suggesting careful operation by the previous owner. Diesel propulsion offers excellent fuel efficiency and range, making extended voyages practical without constant refueling concerns. The inboard drive configuration provides clean aesthetics and maximizes usable deck space. The yacht's accommodation plan includes three heads, reflecting the practical layout expected in a vessel of this size and class. Fuel capacity stands at 475.51 gallons, supporting extended cruising without compromise. Water capacity of 24 gallons and holding capacity of 63.4 gallons round out the essential systems.

The combination of these specifications positions the 510 Sky as a capable platform for both leisurely coastal cruising and more ambitious offshore passages. Galeon's design philosophy emphasizes livability and seaworthiness, and the 510 Sky exemplifies this approach. The modern construction techniques and materials used in this 2020 build ensure the vessel will perform reliably for years to come. The relatively low engine hours suggest the previous owner valued maintenance and careful stewardship, a positive indicator for any prospective buyer.

Located in Miami, the 510 Sky benefits from one of the world's premier yachting hubs. The city offers exceptional service infrastructure, from marine mechanics to provisioning, making ownership and operation straightforward. Miami's position as a gateway to the Caribbean and the Bahamas means this yacht is ideally situated for cruising adventures in some of the world's most desirable waters. Key Specifications:

• Length: 53 feet (16.2 meters); Beam: 14.5 feet

• Twin Volvo Penta D11-670 engines; 1,340 hp combined; 580 hours

• Fuel capacity: 475.51 gallons; Water capacity: 24 gallons; Three heads Main Characteristics:

• Modern 2020 construction with fiberglass hull for durability

• Diesel inboard propulsion for efficiency and range

• Practical three-head layout suitable for extended cruising

• Positioned in Miami for immediate access to Caribbean waters
